data.long_description:
"Every Ritz-Carlton experience has the power to make guests feel special and transcend the ordinary. Enjoy that feeling every day with The Ritz-Carlton Residences, where daily life is elevated with sophisticated style and legendary attention to detail. RITZ Residences provide whole-ownership properties in many of the world's most vibrant cities and stunning resort destinations. It can be yours — always.

Live like a local in unparalleled destinations through the lens of The Ritz-Carlton: sun-soaked penthouse views of the Mediterranean in Cyprus; distinct architectural design and cuisine in Portland, Oregon; striking formal gardens in Amman, Jordan. Your home, anywhere in the world.

Each property is unique but contains many of the signature amenities you have come to expect from The Ritz-Carlton: pristine pools, championship golf courses, tennis courses, lush gardens, fitness centers, serene spas, sweeping terraces, and on-site restaurants and bars.
